subject: biology
source_basis: Actual activity bodies read from locally downloaded official61-page PDF; retained authoring/biology/nie_biology.pdf. Existing source_audit.md details full38-activity inspection.
summary: 17 legacy Biology cases reviewed. All substantive numerical calculations and plotted reciprocals checked; no arithmetic error found. Two source-method mismatches (PM-B08 disc diffusion; PM32-B05 mass change) require explicit associated-enrichment labels. PM33-B01 requires RQ interpretation and spelling corrections. Minor timing-variant/lookup/authorship wording issues documented.

cases.interpretation_audit: Correct reciprocal-time proxy, trend and restricted optimum interpretation. Original handbook uses two-minute endpoint sampling; these second-level endpoint values must be identified as a finer-sampling theoretical variant rather than exact implementation of that timing schedule.

issues.finding: The endpoint times50–240s are not all multiples of the handbook two-minute sampling interval.
issues.recommendation: If claiming exact method alignment, clarify that this fictional rate-proxy dataset assumes finer endpoint timing than the original handbook schedule; do not alter scientifically valid reciprocals.

cases.interpretation_audit: Mass-change osmosis inference is sound and zero net change does not imply no bidirectional water movement. It is not the source-specified measurement.

issues.finding: NIE Practical21 uses Alocasia curvature or potato LENGTH change. PM32-B05 instead presents tissue MASS percentage change.

cases.subject: biology
cases.interpretation_audit: Numerical RQ correct. Substrate wording needs revision:0.800 is more appropriately compatible with protein or mixed fuels and does not uniquely identify either; lipid-rich examples are too suggestive at this specific value.

issues.finding: Specific0.800 result is illustrated as fat-rich respiration; pure-fat RQ is typically near0.7, while protein is often about0.8 and mixtures can produce intermediate values.
issues.recommendation: Replace with: An RQ of0.800 is compatible with protein or mixed respiratory substrates under the model assumptions; it does not uniquely identify the substrate.
